name: MOVA P10 Pro Ultra — original US model
summary: A separately identified vacuum/mop combo with wash/dry base when floor, rug, dock, privacy and ordinary wet-part care all fit.
verdict: Select original P10 Pro Ultra B0DGR1VDTB, part RLM83HE, UPC 850067619260. The November 2 listing did not display the base model: match the received RCME0307 pairing and grounded 120 V / 60 Hz label to the original US manual. That manual names MOVAhome and 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi; use the genuine app with the received regional/model instructions and supported firmware. Check supported region, dock/tank access, floor moisture permission and rug exclusions. Keep physical stair barriers and ordinary wet-part care.
